owner_decision: 2026-10-06: FRESH retains 120-second native event/publication validation; NO_NEW_TRADE additionally requires continuity and no newer unpublished event

scope.name: full_priority_pool
scope.origin: computeStats prioritySet, the exact set used for priority_fresh_quote_coverage_120s

verification_run_id_rule: Unique per frozen publication: shared-water:<SHA256 writer_run_id UTF-8>:<UUID>. Exact-run readback reuses that ID. Consumers obtain a same-scope pointer using externally pinned expectedIdentity; deriving the ID from writer_run_id alone is invalid. Discovery is implemented but not deployed.

hashes.requested_symbols_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(unique full-priority symbols sorted in ASCII order)
hashes.snapshot_symbols_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(unique Snapshot symbols sorted in ASCII order)
hashes.snapshot_bytes_sha256: SHA256 of exact saved Snapshot bytes
hashes.rows_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(rows), ordered by full-priority symbol
hashes.receipt_sha256: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 receipt text
hashes.payload_sha256: SHA256 of archived UTF-8 native event envelope; provider field values preserved, not a claim of original socket frame whitespace
hashes.archive_sha256: SHA256 of compressed archive bytes; each original evidence hash is independently rechecked after decompression

time_rules.quote_event_at: native trade time, never replaced by update/read time
time_rules.write_completed_at: acknowledged HTTP write completion, not inferred database commit timestamp
time_rules.source_asof: minimum observation time across accepted evidence rows; not a trade timestamp
time_rules.fresh_row_validity: no later than the original trade event plus 120 seconds or receipt expiry
time_rules.idle_row_validity: no later than verified observation end plus 30 seconds; native heartbeat must remain within 45 seconds at verification
time_rules.expired_readback: persistence may be COMMITTED but water_gate_pass must be false

limitations: native observations do not prove absence of provider-side packet loss
FRESH does not claim that newer events cannot have arrived after the published event

draft_endpoints.discovery_input: p_expected: trade_date, canonical_run_id, mother_pool_run_id, writer_run_id, generation, snapshot_sequence, requested_symbols_sha256, snapshot_symbols_sha256, snapshot_bytes_sha256, contract_version, scope_definition_version, producer_version
draft_endpoints.discovery_rule: Newest exact-scope receipt, including blocked/expired results. No fallback to an earlier passing receipt. Reader independently checks expiry and receipt identity before loading evidence.

limits.storage_budget_behavior: Draft cap across receipts, compressed archives and raw blobs; insertion over cap rolls back, exact idempotent publications remain readable. Does not include indexes/WAL/physical storage overhead. No automatic deletion; retention/export remains pending.

remaining_acceptance: at least 10 minutes of natural trading-session evidence
Strategy3 actual reader and downstream acceptance
